sentence.en: The fish is in the water.
The baby is in the bath.
I put food on my plate.
I wear gloves in the cold.
The leaf falls from the tree.
On Shabbat, Abba reads us a story.
I drink grape juice for Kiddush.
We light the menorah on Chanukah.
I eat a doughnut on Chanukah.
On Rosh Hashanah, we dip apples in honey.
I wear a crown on Purim.
I wave the flag of Israel.
The boat is on the sea.
